factual_methodology.summary: Period-specific FGV IGP inflation (91.9/35.5/38.8/24.3 for 1964–1967) independently checked in USP historical study; real GDP growth 3.4/2.4/6.7/4.2 confirmed in academic historical tables. Private leadership and electoral vote qualified and attributed to FGV CPDOC. Historical fact and legal/moral responsibility not conflated.

research_depth.summary: Extensive contextual biography in both languages, material political counterevidence, and multiple distinct well-developed topical sections.

evidence_traceability.summary: Verified key quantitative and controversial historical claims against academic or official institutional sources; all numbered citations have bibliography entries.

counterfactual_review.summary: Prose distinguishes historical events from competing explanations and does not infer welfare, political legitimacy or sole authorship from macroeconomic or military results.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Two meaningful source-reproducible charts with compatible units and identical quantitative series in EN/PT-BR; distinct table/flow/geographic visual.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Revised r1 weaknesses: documented historical omissions, correct attribution of contested claims and sources, removed repetitive chapters and unsupported cross-bibliography claims.

contrary_evidence: GDP expansion and falling inflation cannot in isolation demonstrate equitable outcomes or prove necessity of authoritarian policies.
Military evacuation and multinational air defence do not establish that one political figure caused collective wartime outcomes.
limitations: Document-specific pre-publication check with source comparisons; not an exhaustive archival edition nor permanent URL uptime guarantee.
Contested historical allegations are attributed, not automatically accepted as established fact.
notes: Independent review pass over distinct r2 sources, correction of substantive r1 issues confirmed, with fixed blob hashes.
